$description: Wyvrn brand design tokens. Source of truth for every generated artifact in ../generated/wyvrn/. Extracted from the wyvrn.com reference implementation (WyvrnOfficial/wyvrn, src/index.css + tailwind.config.ts), CURATED: known reference bugs are corrected and every deviation is listed in ../recipes/wyvrn-web.md. Harness token names are kept (canvas/surface/accent); the shadcn name mapping lives in the recipes. Canvas is pure black; surfaces sit LIGHTER than the canvas. Glow is sanctioned only through the accent-glow token.

surface.$description: Cards. Lighter than canvas by design.

accent.$description: Wyvrn green. Primary actions, links, focus rings.

on-accent.$description: Label on accent fills (the site's primary-foreground): black text on the green.

accent-glow.$description: The only sanctioned glow. box-shadow color; never glow with any other value.

body.$description: Body copy. Wyvrn uses F5 throughout.

unit.$description: Base grid step. Every spacing value is a multiple of this.

lg.$description: Cards and panels. Base radius of the system.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls: opacity-50 + pointer-events-none, the reference standard across the shadcn set. Sparse exceptions (30, 70) stay at their use sites.

float-soft.$description: The reusable ambient float of wyvrn marketing surfaces. Ambient loops are sanctioned for this brand only; the full motion vocabulary lives in the recipes.
